items.title: Dollar General (DG) Stock Looks Reasonable As Shares Sit 40% Lower
items.summary: Dollar General stock is trading around US$123.41 after a mixed five year run, yet both the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate and earnings based multiples currently point to the shares pricing in a discount rather than a premium. Shareholders have seen the stock decline about 40.4% over the last 5 years, which suggests the market has become more cautious on Dollar General despite more recent gains.
